title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza
description: Two staff members of Doctors Without Borders in Gaza were killed by an Israeli strike. The Israeli army identified them as Hamas members, while MSF condemned the attack.
text: Jerusalem: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said Saturday an Israeli strike killed two staff members at a clinic in Gaza, with the Israeli army labelling the pair as Hamas “terrorists.”
The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) identified the men, who worked as security guards at the clinic, as Hamas artillery cell commander Moaz Yousef Alitsbach and Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu.
MSF said it was “devastated” by the killings and denounced “a direct hit” on the organization.
“Our premises were clearly marked with MSF logos, and their location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military,” it wrote on X.
World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus slammed the attack.
“Attacks on health facilities, health workers and humanitarian personnel in #Gaza are outrageous and unacceptable,” he posted on X.
The IDF denied targeting a hospital or damaging medical infrastructure.
“This is another example of the Hamas terrorist organization embedding itself within international organizations,” it posted on Telegram.
